name: Morse Code Radio
shortDescription: Translate text to morse code, hear it transmitted with Web Audio API, and key manually with the on-screen or spacebar key.

generation.notes: Static HTML/CSS/JS app with Web Audio API oscillator for morse code audio, canvas oscilloscope visualization, animated dot/dash symbols, manual key button, speed/frequency sliders, and collapsible reference chart. Mobile-first responsive design with touch support.
